newsitem.title: USA: CSCE to raise margins on "C" coffee futures.
newsitem.headline: CSCE to raise margins on "C" coffee futures.

text.p: The Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange (CSCE) said Monday it will raise margins on March 1997 "C" coffee contracts by $750 to $3,500, effective Feb. 11.
Margins on May 1997 "C" coffee contracts will also be raised by $750, to $3,000, the exchange said in a statement.
The CSCE said margins on all other coffee contracts will be increased by $250 to $2,500.
The changes come less than two weeks after the exchange raised the spot margin by $250 and the margins on all other contracts by $250.
For customers who are not exchange members or a member of the trade, margins will be 140 percent above trade rates, CSCE said. ((--Patricia Avidan, New York Commodities Desk, 212 859 1640))
